final_message: Parsed the log file by reading each entry and its extra lines. Filtered only ERROR and CRITICAL entries (case insensitive). Converted timestamps to UTC ISO format. Extracted message after "<service>: ". Extracted last line of traceback or null if none. Summed repeat counts from following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. Counted total repeats per service. Wrote results to workspace/errors.json in the required JSON structure.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.

checks.name: rule_schema_header
checks.detail: RULE: the top-level object has "schema_version": 2 and "generated_by": "log-triage".
